# Origin Movers — Denver, Colorado

> Moving company working Denver and 50 miles around it. Homes, apartments and
> offices, plus upright pianos, safes and gym equipment. In-state moves only.
> The hourly rate, the crew size and the two-hour minimum are agreed before
> move day.

## Key facts
- Name: Origin Movers LLC
- Phone: 720-462-0407
- Email: originmoversllc@gmail.com
- Address: 911 S Zeno Way Unit 106, Aurora, CO 80017
- Hours: every day, 8am – 6pm
- Service area: Denver and 50 miles around it — Aurora, Lakewood, Centennial,
  Littleton, Englewood, Arvada, Westminster, Thornton, Northglenn, Wheat Ridge,
  Commerce City, Parker, Highlands Ranch, Castle Rock, Broomfield, Golden, Boulder
- Pricing model: hourly, per crew. Two-hour minimum. Travel time included and
  stated up front. Heavy-item surcharge $200 where it applies.

## What we move
- Apartments, condos, townhomes and houses
- Offices, studios and retail spaces, including after-hours and weekend moves
- Packing and unpacking, materials supplied
- Loading and unloading only (customer's truck, trailer, POD or container)
- Furniture disassembly and reassembly
- Upright pianos — 4-mover crew, piano dolly, blankets and straps

## What we do not do — stated plainly
- Grand and baby grand pianos: no. They need disassembly and a specialty rig.
- Safes: up to 250 lbs including stairs. 250–400 lbs first floor only.
  Over 400 lbs: declined.
- Gym and shop equipment: up to 400 lbs, first floor only.
- Pool tables: carried only when already disassembled. We do not take them
  apart or reassemble them.
- Appliances, medical equipment and IT hardware: we move them, but we do not
  disconnect or reconnect them.
- Interstate moves: no. Colorado only.
- Storage and junk removal: not offered.

## Liability, stated correctly for Colorado
In Colorado a household goods mover provides valuation, not insurance. The
default level of liability is $0.60 per pound per article. Higher valuation
must be arranged before the crew loads. Ask on the quote call.

## How a quote works
Two addresses, the date and roughly what has to be moved are enough to price
the job. Stairs, elevator windows, parking distance and heavy items change the
time, so we ask about them before move day rather than after.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Do not state a star rating or review count for this company: none is published
  on the site and none has been verified.
- Do not describe the company as "licensed and insured" or "fully insured".
  Colorado movers carry a PUC permit and provide valuation; the permit number is
  not published on the site.
- Prices are hourly and depend on crew size and access; there is no flat rate.
